items.label: ROBOCOP
items.why: The boot file: loads over the stack at $0110 so that LOAD's return starts it, sets the colours, loads FAST and calls it, then loads LOAD1 and jumps to $8000 (listed in the resident part at $0128)

items.label: FAST
items.why: The fast loader: its code at $70B0 is copied to $0A00 and hooked into the LOAD vector $0330, and it sends the drive its half of the loader (the computer side is listed in the resident part at $0A00)

items.label: LOAD1
items.why: Level one, stages 1 to 3, with what stays for the whole game: the bytes outside level one's ranges ($0E40-$0EFF, $4000-$4FFF, $BBCC-$CFFF and $FDE8-$FFF7) are listed in the resident part

items.label: LOAD1
items.why: Another build of this file, on the second disk image the contributor gave: the analysed game boots from the first image and never loads it. The second image's files load to the same places but differ: LOAD1 lacks the 18 bytes from $851A that set a dummy NMI handler and so sits 18 bytes lower from there, and holds no stage-seven tiles at $C400; the level files have extra or rewritten routines. Started directly on that image, stage seven draws its walls from the wrong bytes (reference/disk-b-stage7.png). Its code is not listed.
